title: Restriction/unit equation for Cartesian tensor transport
statement: Fix a finite commutative ring $A$ and ordinary unbounded fixed-scalar derived categories $D_A(T)$ and actual operations of [def-sf-finite-open-tensor-operations]. Let $i:W\hookrightarrow Y$, $i':W'\hookrightarrow Y'$ and scheme isomorphisms $g:Y\simeq Y'$, $h:W\simeq W'$ form a Cartesian square. Let $R',H'\in D_A(Y')$, $P',Q'\in D_A(W')$, $a':i'^*R'\simeq P'$, $b':i'^*H'\simeq Q'$. For any arrow $f':R'\otimes H'\to i'_!(P'\otimes Q')$ satisfying $i'^*f'=\mu_{i'};(a'\otimes b');\eta^{i'}$, set $a=\theta_{R'};h^*a'$, $b=\theta_{H'};h^*b'$ using the specified composition square $\theta:i^*g^*\simeq h^*i'^*$. Then $i^*(\mu_g^{-1};g^*f';\beta;i_!\mu_h)=\mu_i;(a\otimes b);\eta^i$. No invertibility of $f'$ is assumed. All objects are arbitrary unbounded complexes.

proof.text: write U=i*, V=i'*, G=g*, T=h*, J=i!, J'=i'!, and theta for the specified square. Naturality of theta rewrites UG(f') as theta at the source, then T(V(f')), then theta inverse at the target. Substitute hf'. The unit-normalized beta equation cancels T(eta') followed by theta inverse and U(beta), leaving eta at T(P' tensor Q'). Move the final tensor comparison past eta by unit naturality. Tensor-comparison composition coherence identifies the remaining source composite with mu_i followed by tensor(theta at R', theta at H') and tensor(T(a'), T(b')). Tensor naturality moves a', b' through mu_h; the factors U(mu_g inverse) and U(mu_g) cancel. This is precisely the displayed right side. All calculations take place on arbitrary unbounded objects; they can be checked on flat-term K-flat representatives, where they are the ordinary pullback tensor identities on each total-complex summand, and descend by the localization universal property.

lean.statement:
theorem supportedTensor_cartesian_unit
    {W Y W' Y' : Scheme.{u}} (i : W ⟶ Y) (i' : W' ⟶ Y')
    [IsOpenImmersion i] [IsOpenImmersion i']
    (g : Y ≅ Y') (h : W ≅ W') (s : IsPullback h.hom i i' g.hom)
    (R' H' : FiniteD A Y') (P' Q' : FiniteD A W')
    (a' : (pull A i').obj R' ≅ P') (b' : (pull A i').obj H' ≅ Q')
    (f' : tensor A Y' R' H' ⟶ (finiteShriek A i').obj (tensor A W' P' Q'))
    (hf' : (pull A i').map f' = (tensorPullIso A i' R' H').hom ≫
      tensorMap A W' a'.hom b'.hom ≫ (adj A i').unit.app (tensor A W' P' Q')) :
    (pull A i).map
      ((tensorPullIso A g.hom R' H').inv ≫ (pull A g.hom).map f' ≫
        (beta A h.hom i i' g.hom s).hom.app (tensor A W' P' Q') ≫
        (finiteShriek A i).map (tensorPullIso A h.hom P' Q').hom) =
      (tensorPullIso A i ((pull A g.hom).obj R') ((pull A g.hom).obj H')).hom ≫
        tensorMap A W
          (((square A i g.hom h.hom i' s.w.symm).app R' ≪≫
            (pull A h.hom).mapIso a').hom)
          (((square A i g.hom h.hom i' s.w.symm).app H' ≪≫
            (pull A h.hom).mapIso b').hom) ≫
        (adj A i).unit.app
          (tensor A W ((pull A h.hom).obj P') ((pull A h.hom).obj Q'))
